messages:
Alex: Heads up — promotion job for v2.4.1 just failed in the final stage. Build logs show the base image pulled a different digest on the promotion runner and integration tests are throwing glibc symbol errors.

Alex: Error excerpt:```
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: undefined symbol: __libc_enable_ptf
Container image: registry.internal/redwood/base:2026-03-19 (expected digest sha256:aaa111...)
Pulled digest: sha256:bbb222...
```

deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: release v2.4.1 -> production blocked (artifact provenance mismatch). See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.io/pipelines/6789/jobs/2345

Maria: Ugh. We saw a couple of flaky pulls earlier but assumed registry GC noise. This one looks reproducible on the promotion runner.

Cheng: The different digest suggests the tag was moved or the registry served a recreated image. Did the base-image team roll a rebuild? @Sam do you know if the base image was rebuilt today?

Sam: I triggered a small patch to update glibc in our base yesterday to pick up CVE patch — that created a new digest but I thought we pinned the promotion job to the digest. Looks like the pin didn't propagate to the promotion runner.

Jen: Quick triage options: 1) Pin Dockerfile FROM to the original digest and re-run; 2) Force promotion to use the built, signed artifact from the staging registry (if available); 3) Roll back the PR that updated the base and re-run CI.

SRE-Oncall: We should avoid force-promoting different digests. Can we verify the signed artifact in staging before any manual override? I can add a quick provenance check step to the promotion job to compare image digests against the staging registry.

Alex: For immediate unblock, I propose pinning IMAGE_BASE_SHA in the promotion job env to the expected digest (sha256:aaa111...) and re-run. That keeps the binary matching what passed tests in CI. We should still follow up with a rollback or rebase of the base-image change.

Maria: Works for me. Add the env override in the pipeline UI for the v2.4.1 promotion job and re-run. Also open a ticket to ensure tag immutability on release tags.

Cheng: Adding a short snippet for the pipeline override:```yaml
# pipeline override (promotion job)
env:
  IMAGE_BASE_SHA: "sha256:aaa111..."
steps:
  - promote:
      image: registry.internal/redwood/app:${IMAGE_BASE_SHA}
```

Sam: I'll create PR to pin the Dockerfile FROM to the digest and add an integration test that validates digest equality between build and promotion registries. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/base-images/pulls/89

deploy-bot: Promotion job re-run queued by Maria. Job: https://ci.redwood.io/pipelines/6789/jobs/2350

SRE-Oncall: Follow-up items: 1) enforce tag immutability for 'base:YYYY-MM-DD' tags (ticket #3428), 2) add provenance check step to promotion job (ticket #3429), 3) document emergency fix workflow for image digest drift. I'll file those.

Alex: Thanks. If the re-run succeeds we'll proceed with the canary. If not, we'll revert Sam's base-image patch and re-run full CI.

Jen: Noted — keeping the change window team updated in release channel. :thumbsup:
